🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Spain’s CSD (Higher Sports Council) has filed a complaint against LaLiga president Javier Tebas with the TAD (Sport Administrative Court) over his remarks about Real Madrid TV.

Tebas compared RMTV to Nazi propaganda, prompting the Spanish government to act and refer the matter to sports authorities. He had  said Real Madrid’s leadership “directs an orchestra of mouthpieces” and that Real Madrid TV uses Goebbels-style propaganda by selecting convenient incidents, repeating grievances and fuelling suspicion. [@diarioas] ⚖️

🚨 Lionel Messi has arrived in Oviedo, Spain in style.

The GOAT will have dinner tonight with King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia before receiving the prestigious 2026 Princess of Asturias Award for Sports tomorrow, recognising his outstanding career. 🐐

🚨🎙️| Jürgen Klopp: “Of course I’ll watch El Clásico. I’ve watched this game throughout my life. In the past, I leaned more towards Barcelona because I disliked the behaviour of Pepe and some of Real Madrid’s other defenders. Nowadays, I support the BETTER team, and given the current situation, that’s probably Barcelona.” #fcblive 😁

🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Rodri has become the HIDDEN LEADER in Barcelona’s dressing room. He has gained significant influence and commands the same respect as a team captain, despite not wearing the armband. When he speaks, everyone listens. Some people at the club even view him as Flick's assistant coach because of the constant discussions he has with the coach regarding the game. [@CatalunyaRadio] #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Enric Masip, on Arda Güler’s elbow: “Did anyone not see that assault? Do you remember what happened with Lamine’s goal at Bernabeu 2 years ago? By coincidence, the camera angle that could have shown whether the ball crossed the line wasn’t working that day.

Things always seem to go in the same team’s favour. Yet we didn’t start a war over it; we simply moved on. We don’t spend our days crying, making accusations or pointing fingers at others.” [@forcabarca_ar] #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Enric Masip: “Mourinho claiming to see strange things in La Liga? When certain people come out and say they see strange things… tell them that the real strange thing is STICKING your FINGER in a coach’s EYE.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Ramón Calderón (Real Madrid president 2006-2009): “Real Madrid’s stance right now is a personal TANTRUM after Barcelona decided NOT to continue with the Super League project. There’s no other reason. A year and nine months after the Negreira case emerged, Pérez said Barcelona and Real Madrid should remain 'united'.

Complaining about referees is something small teams do. Constantly talking about referees makes us look like a club that isn’t great.” ⚪

🚨🎙️| Lionel Messi: “What does FC Barcelona mean to me? So many beautiful things, it’s hard to sum up what FC Barcelona means in just a few words.. I feel a very special love for the city and the club.”#fcblive 🥺❤️

🚨🎙️| Lionel Messi: “In Barcelona, we were lucky to win everything, not only because of what we achieved, but also because of the way we did it, and how much we enjoyed playing, winning, and achieving important milestones. But the most important thing was enjoying the details of daily life, the training sessions, and the beautiful moments we spent together.” #fcblive 🐐❤️
